message:
Command `cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('analysis.json')
text=p.read_text()
text=text.replace('"line":300,"operands":["tlv.GetLength()"]}','"line":503,"operands":["aLength"]')
text=text.replace('"line":300,"code":"length = tlv.GetLength();","role":"source","note":"The attacker-controlled GET option length is copied into the local TLV selector count."','"line":503,"code":"tlv.SetLength(aLength);","role":"source","note":"The commissioner copies the attacker-controlled selector count into the outgoing GET TLV length."')
text=text.replace('"line":308,"var":"tlvs","code":"SendCommissioningGetResponse(aMessage, aMessageInfo, tlvs, length);","role":"intermediate","note":"The parsed selector bytes and their count are forwarded into the response builder."','"line":308,"var":"tlvs","code":"SendCommissioningGetResponse(aMessage, aMessageInfo, tlvs, length);","role":"intermediate","note":"The parsed selector bytes and their count are forwarded into the response builder."')
text=text.replace('"line":338,"var":"data && length","code":"VerifyOrExit(data && length, error = OT_ERROR_DROP);","role":"root_cause","note":"The code assumes the commissioning dataset TLV exists and has a nonzero length before iterating its contents."','"line":338,"var":"data && length","code":"VerifyOrExit(data && length, error = OT_ERROR_DROP);","role":"root_cause","note":"The code assumes the commissioning dataset TLV exists and has a nonzero length before iterating its contents."')
text=text.replace('"line":349,"var":"cur < reinterpret_cast<MeshCoP::Tlv *>(data + length)","code":"for (MeshCoP::Tlv *cur = reinterpret_cast<MeshCoP::Tlv *>(data); cur < reinterpret_cast<MeshCoP::Tlv *>(data + length); cur = cur->GetNext())","role":"sink","note":"The loop walks MeshCoP TLVs inside the commissioning data buffer and can read past the valid object when the length is malformed."','"line":349,"var":"cur < reinterpret_cast<MeshCoP::Tlv *>(data + length)","code":"for (MeshCoP::Tlv *cur = reinterpret_cast<MeshCoP::Tlv *>(data); cur < reinterpret_cast<MeshCoP::Tlv *>(data + length); cur = cur->GetNext())","role":"sink","note":"The loop walks MeshCoP TLVs inside the commissioning data buffer and can read past the valid object when the length is malformed."')
p.write_text(text)
PY
